name: Jillybean
summary: **Jillybean** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:MzJill Genetics|MzJill Genetics]], a cross of an orange-skunk phenotype called [[orange-velvet|Orange Velvet]] with a [[space-queen|Space Queen]] male. MzJill developed it in the mid-2000s while co-running [[breeder:TGA Genetics|TGA Genetics]] with Subcool in Oregon and Northern California, [[country:US|United States]], and it ranked among the Top 10 Strains of 2007.

sources.title: Jillybean (MzJill Genetics)
sources.note: Breeder-submitted genetics (Orange Velvet x Space Queen) and flowering time.

sources.title: The Story of MzJill Genetics
